key_insight: Circumferential 3D Laser Diagnostics (3DLD) can reveal polyethylene butt-fusion weld geometry linked to joint quality that static bead dimensions or machine logs alone may miss.
engineering_relevance: Integrating 3DLD with Dynamic Site-Specific Calibration (DSSC) could support field quality control and create weld digital twins for pipeline records and service-life monitoring.
method: Correlate relative profile discrepancy (Kn), groove root fillet radius (Rc), and bead convergence angle (αz) with tensile results.
Classify joints as defect-free, locally unstable, or critically defective.
evidence_signal: Retrospective analysis of Ø160 × 14.6 mm PE 100 SDR 11 pipe joints correlated replica geometry with tensile tests per GOST R 52779, supporting three geometric quality states.
watch_item: The abstract does not report sample size or predictive accuracy; broader field validation is needed before generalizing to other pipe sizes and conditions.
paper_title: Potential Capabilities of 3DLD Technology: From Non-Destructive Welding Quality Control to a Digital Twin of a Polyethylene Pipe Joint
